stem: Which component gives a quick form to view or edit one record with minimal code?
explanation: record-form is the quickest and record-view-form and record-edit-form add control.

stem: What does Lightning Data Service respect?

options.text: Nothing, it runs in system mode

explanation: LDS enforces user permissions and shares a cache.

stem: What does '$recordId' in a wire configuration do?

options.text: Makes the wire reactive to changes of recordId
Hardcodes the Id so that the wire never changes
Converts the Id into a string before the wire runs
Declares a constant that the wire cannot change

explanation: A dollar-prefixed value is reactive and re-runs the wire when it changes.

stem: Which adapter gets a record's field values?
explanation: getRecord from lightning/uiRecordApi returns record data.

stem: Which annotation must an Apex method have to be called from LWC?
explanation: Methods must be @AuraEnabled and static.

stem: What does a @wire call to an Apex method require?
explanation: Wired Apex methods must be @AuraEnabled(cacheable=true).

stem: A method inserts records. How must LWC call it?
explanation: Cacheable methods cannot do DML, so a DML method is called imperatively.

stem: Which function refreshes wired Apex data after a change?
explanation: refreshApex(wiredResult) re-runs a wired Apex call and refreshes the cache. Call it after an imperative update so the list on screen shows the new data.

stem: What is the correct way for a child to notify its parent?
explanation: Data flows down through public properties and events flow up. A child dispatches a CustomEvent and the parent listens with an on-prefixed handler.

stem: Where does an event put the data it carries?

options.text: In the target property of the event object
In the name of the event as a string
In the bubbles property of the event object

explanation: CustomEvent carries its payload in the detail property, for example new CustomEvent('select', { detail: { id } }). The parent reads event.detail.

stem: Which is a valid custom event name for LWC?
explanation: Names should be lowercase with no spaces or hyphens.

stem: How does a parent send data to a child component?

options.text: By setting the child's public @api property
By dispatching an event that the child listens for
By changing the child's CSS so that it reads the data
With a trigger on the child's object

explanation: Parent sets public properties or calls @api methods.

stem: How does the parent listen to a 'select' event in the template?
explanation: Handlers use the 'on' prefix and the event name.

stem: Which feature lets unrelated components on a page exchange messages?

options.text: Parent properties passed down from the top component
Custom labels shared between the components
Platform cache that stores the message for them

explanation: LMS uses message channels and works across LWC, Aura and Visualforce.

stem: Which feature navigates to records or pages from an LWC?
explanation: NavigationMixin gives components a Navigate method that opens records, list views, tabs and web pages. It keeps navigation working in Lightning Experience and the mobile app.

stem: Which event shows a toast message?
explanation: ShowToastEvent from lightning/platformShowToastEvent shows toasts.

stem: Which tool is used to unit test LWC?
explanation: LWC unit tests run in Jest using the @salesforce/sfdx-lwc-jest package. Wire adapters and Apex calls are mocked so tests run on your machine without an org.

stem: When is LDS preferred over Apex?

options.text: Working with a single record with built-in security and caching
Complex logic that joins several objects and many records at once
Callouts to external systems that need a stored credential
Large aggregate queries that group thousands of rows by field

explanation: LDS reduces code and respects security for single-record work.

stem: What do bubbles and composed control on a CustomEvent?

options.text: Whether the event propagates up and crosses shadow boundaries
Which data the event carries, by default in its detail property
The name of the event that the parent component listens for
Which handler function runs first when several components listen to it

explanation: Bubbles lets it pass up the DOM and composed lets it cross shadow DOM boundaries.

stem: Which TWO are ways to send data from parent to child? (Choose 2)

options.text: Dispatch a CustomEvent from the child
Use a wire adapter in the child

explanation: Parent to child uses public properties or methods.

stem: Wired Apex result is stale after a button saved data. What do you call?

options.text: dispatchEvent on the component that saved the data
connectedCallback again, so the component reloads
Navigate to the same page so that the data reloads

explanation: refreshApex refreshes cached wire results.

options.text: The method must be @AuraEnabled(cacheable=true) to be wired
The method must return a Map
The method must be called imperatively with await

explanation: Wired Apex methods must be cacheable. Methods that change data cannot be cacheable and are called imperatively.

stem: After a user clicks Save, an imperative Apex call updates a record, but the wired list on the page still shows the old data. What should the developer call?
explanation: refreshApex re-reads a wired result so the page shows the new data.

stem: Which TWO statements about @wire are true? (Choose 2)

options.text: It needs an Apex method with cacheable=true when it calls Apex
A $ prefix makes a parameter reactive
It can be used to call Apex methods that insert records
It runs only when a button is clicked

explanation: Wire is reactive and supports only cacheable reads. Changes need imperative calls.
